description: Find broken links on a web page: collects every link on the page and checks each one (up to 200, in parallel), returning the broken ones with their status code or error and link text. Links that answer 401/403/429 (often bot protection) are listed separately. Use when maintaining a site, auditing content or before publishing. Optional limit (default 100, max 200). Returns {linksFound, checked, ok, broken, blockedOrRestricted}. Errors: 400 bad or private URL. Price: $0.01 USDC per call (x402).

url.description: Page whose links to check (http/https, public)

name: broken_link_check
title: Broken link checker
